title: arthraxon microphyllus
intro: Arthraxon microphyllus, commonly known as Pithy Aristolochia or Wild Potato, is a species of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. This plant has been found to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Arthraxon microphyllus include its ability to treat fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
